_note: Edit this when you buy, sell, or enter new stop orders. 'current_stop' is what you actually have live on Robinhood right now - set it to null if you have no stop on that coin, and the next run will tell you what to enter. 'spread_pct' is the 'Buy spread (x%)' figure from the coin's order ticket; it drifts slowly, so re-read it every few weeks. 'room_override_pct' forces a width instead of the measured one; leave null to let the script decide. 'routing' is how a sale executes: 'exchange' (Fee tiers on, itemized taker fee), 'market_maker' (spread in the price) or 'unknown' (treated as exchange). It sets the breakeven floor: once current_stop is at or above breakeven, the script never recommends a stop below it. 'bought' is the Central-time date the lot was bought (one lot per coin per day). 'stop_placed' is the date the live stop order was entered: Robinhood cancels good-til-canceled orders 90 days after they are placed, so whenever a stop is entered or re-entered (even at the same price) this date changes too; stop_check.py warns from day 80. The '_' settings above the positions drive which alerts may buzz: _lot_size_usd is the current ladder step, _buys_allowed is false while a standing rule blocks new lots (_buys_note says which), _max_open_coins (coins held at once; a coin's lots count once; 10 since 2026-10-19, the ten-year replay's slot count) and _crypto_cost_cap_usd are the standing caps, and _crash_budget_usd caps the crash case: the loss against cost if every coin fell as far below its stop as on Oct 10, 2025, a new lot included ($11,500 + realized P&L since 10-05, kept current by Claude; each coin's gap is in crash_gaps.json) (claude/trading-strategy.md section 0).
_tax_lot_rule: Standing order for 2026 sales (IRS Notice 2026-20, recorded 2026-10-16): each crypto sale disposes of the lot(s) its order was placed for, as listed here and in the trade log when the order was placed; if an order covering several lots fills only in part, the highest-cost lot goes first. A sale with no recorded lot follows FIFO.
